Three sausage pieces at about 15 g each come to roughly 45 g. At about 300 kcal per 100 g, that is about 135 kcal.

The pineapple is about 10 chunks at roughly 8 g each, so about 80 g, or about 40 kcal.

The strawberries are about 8 halves, so roughly 90 g, or about 29 kcal.

There are about 8 blueberries, roughly 8 g, or about 5 kcal.

That totals about 223 g and about 210 kcal.
